_comment: Raw chat answer -> the real Instagram handle. ONLY for typos no rule can repair: a missing or doubled letter, a word the lead invented. Case, spaces, dots-vs-underscores and a dropped _tm are all handled by candidates() in profiles.py and must NOT be listed here. Found by searching Instagram by hand -- Meta has no username-search endpoint, so a person is the only resolver for these. Keys match the answer as it sits in «Заявки», loosely (case and extra spaces are ignored).
